name: Stopwatch
description: A REDCap External Module that provides a stopwatch widget that can be integrated into data entry forms or surveys. Results (elapsed time, times started/stopped) can be captured in a number of ways. For more details and to report bugs, please see this module's GitHub page.

action-tags.description:
When added to a field on a form, this will turn the field into a stopwatch widget. The result of the stopwatch measurement will be written into this field, provided it is of a compatible type, or another field, if so configured using the 'target' parameter. The looks and behavior of the stopwatch widget can be controlled via a JSON object that is passed as an argument to the action tag:
@STOPWATCH=
{
  "parameter": "value"
}
For more details and examples, please refer to the full module documentation.

Adds a stopwatch that can record multiple captures of the (until then) elapsed time. Configuration is done the same way as for the @STOPWATCH action tag. For more details and examples, please refer to the full module documentation.
Adds a stopwatch that can record multiple laps. Configuration is done the same way as for the @STOPWATCH action tag. For more details and examples, please refer to the full module documentation.
